english: Hello / Greetings!
May you be blessed with longevity (Response to Khamma Ghani)
Ram Ram (universal greeting)
Welcome to our land / Welcome home!
hindi: हमारे देश / घर में आपका स्वागत है

english: How are you?
hindi: आप कैसे हैं? / क्या हाल चाल है?
rajasthani: थें कियां हो सा? / कांई हाल-चाल है?
roman: Then kiyan ho sa? / Kaain haal-chaal hai?

english: I am fine / Everything is great.
hindi: मैं बिल्कुल ठीक हूँ / सब बढ़िया है।
rajasthani: म्हूँ बिल्कुल चोखो हूँ सा / सगळो चोखो है।
roman: Mhoon bilkul chokho hoon sa / Saglo chokho hai.

english: What is your name?
My name is Ram.
Where are you going?
rajasthani: थें कठे जा रह्या हो सा?
roman: Then kathe jaa rahya ho sa?

english: I am going to the village.
Please have some tea and water.
Please have some food.
Thank you very much.
Please visit again / Come to my house.
What is the time right now?
The weather is very pleasant today.
rajasthani: आज मौसम घणो चोखो है सा।
roman: Aaj mausam ghano chokho hai sa.

english: What is the price of this?
hindi: इसका क्या भाव है / यह कितने का है?
rajasthani: ईंरो कांई भाव है सा? / कित्ता रुपिया है?
roman: Eenro kaain bhaav hai sa? / Kitta rupiya hai?

english: Which way does this road go?
Please grace us and come feast!
Abundant greetings, noble lord/sir!
Heartfelt and immense gratitude to you.
May you abide in perpetual bliss and joy.

rajasthani: पाणी पीवो सा, छाया मांय विराजो।
roman: Paani peevo sa, chhaaya maany viraajo.
hindi: पानी पीजिए सा, छाया में बैठिए।
english: Have some cool water, please take your seat in the cool shade.

rajasthani: धीरज राखो, सगळो काम चोखो व्हैला।
roman: Dheeraj raakho, sagalo kaam chokho vhaila.
hindi: धैर्य रखिए, सब काम अच्छा होगा।
english: Keep patience, everything will turn out splendidly.

hindi: कल फिर हम सब इकट्ठा मिलेंगे।
english: Tomorrow we shall all gather together again.
